description:
FILED s407 (fable-answers-s406.md §4.8 ask 2 — RULED YES).  s406 measured 22 of
36 companion differences as pure CONTENTION (files that spawn fresh_perl/
runperl children lose rows under --jobs 4; #348 made the run busier); each
reproduced the snapshot when re-run alone.  Today that re-run is a rule the
operator must remember (DECIDED s406); the runner should do it, exactly as the
sweep re-runs a LOST file serially (#215).
SHAPE: after the parallel pass, collect files whose (status, C_ok, C_notok)
differ from docs/perl-suite-run.tsv; re-run them serially (--jobs 1) at the end;
print BOTH values per file and take the serial one as the verdict; CAP the set
(40 files) and print when the cap bites, so a broken tree cannot double the
wall time; a file that differs in BOTH runs is a real move.  --quick and --all
alike.  Also the sweep's own LOST re-run stays as it is.
BAR (runners row): the runner that changed, once, verdicts compared file-by-file
before/after on the same tree; PCL_SHOW_SBCL=1 byte-identical.


DONE s408 (Opus 5).  After the parallel pass the runner re-runs every file whose
(status, C_ok, C_notok) differs from docs/perl-suite-run.tsv, ONE AT A TIME,
prints BOTH values and takes the SERIAL one as the verdict; capped at 40 with
the cap PRINTED when it bites.  The registry classification was EXTRACTED into
classify_result() so the serial pass cannot reach a different verdict than the
parallel one -- two copies would be two verdicts for the same file.

ONE HOLE, MADE COUNTABLE: the phase sits after the dispatch loop, and a full
--all run is SIGTERMed by op/cond.t's memory guard about half the time (2 of 4
full runs this session), so it does not always run.  The report now SAYS the
re-run did not happen rather than leaving its absence to be inferred.

VERIFIED live on mro/package_aliases_utf8.t (the registered rows-unstable file):
detected as a mover, re-run alone, both values printed.
subject: The companion RUNNER re-runs a moved row ALONE (the #215 shape) — a file whose verdict/counts differ from the snapshot gets one serial re-run at the end, both values reported, serial = verdict
